conclusions.supply: Independent-shutter microsecond thresholds reproduced, but not selected by the inherited snapshot. Static bits do not average down. Finite correlations lengthen the threshold and require explicit refresh resources.
conclusions.photons: The current shift and fixed SOURCE interaction predict no energy-dependent vacuum dispersion. The SOURCE ensemble gives an achromatic arrival-time distribution and nonselective pulse broadening, verified by FFT.
conclusions.CMB_higher: Actual seven-mode CMB projection of conditional non-Gaussian SOURCE moments executed, including rotational bispectra and connected angular power covariance. A custom NG map likelihood and nonlinear non-Gaussian lens remapping are not executed.
